name: harness
description: Managed Codex workflow for evidence-based completion with Harness Core.

interface.shortDescription: Managed evidence workflow for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Run a managed, conversation-scoped workflow that drafts a Harness Task, connects ordinary implementation to one approved verification, carries the exact Evidence identity to a safe handoff, and supports explicit bundle or completion follow-ups.
defaultPrompt: $harness Swagger/OpenAPI를 도입하고 한글 API 설명까지 검증해줘
$harness:verify 기존 Task를 한 번 검증하고 Run ID와 Evidence 경로를 보여줘
$harness:bundle 지정한 Task와 Run의 verifier bundle을 준비해줘
